name: The Chastity Scholarship
source:
What happens when the only way to pay for college is a chastity scholarship to an all-girls university?

You lock it up!

Starting a new life at university is already difficult, but it's even harder when your cute roommate, Charlotte, is completely in charge of your chastity cage. Adjust to your new tiny prison while doing your best to make to make Charlotte happy. 

Do you behave like a good chastity student, or do you make selfish decisions that annoy the girls around you?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3384140/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
当支付大学学费的唯一途径是获得女子大学的贞洁奖学金时，会发生什么？

你把它锁起来！

在大学开始新的生活已经很困难了，但当你可爱的室友夏洛特完全掌控你的贞操笼时，这就更难了。适应你的新小监狱，同时尽最大努力让夏洛特开心。

你的行为是否像一个良好的贞操学生，或者你是否做出了令周围女孩烦恼的自私决定？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3384140/]Steam[/url]]
